notes.title: Version 2.0.0 Update : Cocoa Mode now available in DLC "Before Next Adventure"!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11358524/475fd1aa176bed20bcc593337979b4c324912b6c.jpg[/img]

Rabi-Ribi 5th Anniversary! Version 2.0.0 is now released!

In this update the DLC "Before Next Adventure" is renamed to "Cocoa Mode & Before Next Adventure",
players can now play as Cocoa to explore the Rabi Rabi Island!

Since the additional of Cocoa Mode, we will change the price of the DLC from 6.99 USD to 7.99 USD on February 8th.
Both name change and price change will not affect the players who already owned the DLC.

Cocoa have a complete different play style compare to Erina. 
For more details, please visit the DLC store page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1015050/

notes.title: "Is the order a DLC?" release and New UPRPRC!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/d1e4fab5837bcdf126e5cbf1e66f905134eb5f67.jpg[/img]
"Is the order a DLC?" has been release and everything's 15% off for the whole week!
New areas to explore, new bosses, and new items are now on the menu!
Climb up Rabi-Rabi Ravine to play with Ribbon's friends, and head down to the Hall of Memories to reminisce about the past...
Erina also gets a working wardrobe to freely change between all her outfits!
http://store.steampowered.com/app/532021/RabiRibi__Is_the_order_a_DLC/

[h1]New UPRPRC Edition[/h1]
There's a new Super UPRPRC Edition in town which includes the new DLC.
Just as a refresher getting the UPRPRC gets you Rabi-Ribi with the new DLC, the full Soundtrack (that updates with new content) and the Artbook. That also means you get new (but experimental) difficulties, unused beta content, and a portrait viewer. Who knew you could put so many things in a digital artbook?
http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/591/RabiRibi_Super_UPRPRC_Edition/

[h1]Rabi Rabi Island Voting Contest[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/b0eabe16330b60037ed4ff8368190d51a8659bfc.jpg[/img]
There are three weeks left until October 1st so there's still time to put in your ballots!
*Enter voting by pressing F1/F2 in the main menu!


[h1]Custom Map[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/bb1f8991f264ef371309a155e6bd0b58b1500722.png[/img]
Also, we launched a test function. In this function, players can load their custom maps by pressing F5/F6 in the main menu. 
For more about creating custom maps, please visit one of these map editors by our great Rabi-Ribi speedrun community members:
 
https://wcko87.github.io/rabiribi-map-editing/  By wcko87 
https://github.com/D3nD3nD3n/rbrb-Map-Viewer  By d3n

*Custom map support was made because we were surprised to see map editors out there already.
The idea of this function is to make it easier to install and test out maps. This function might not be fully completed or supported in the future, but we hope Rabi-Ribi can make use of Steam Workshop in the future.

[h1]Other ver1.85 changes[/h1]
- Added launch option "-fullload" to load everything before the game display the first screen.
- Change some sound effects.
- Fixed text stopping advancing in "INSTANT" text speed or text skipping.
- Added new music tracks in "SOUNDTRACK DLC"
- Added new characters in "ARTBOOK DLC"

notes.title: Cicini's Halloween Update Ver 1.70!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/29ddeb7e1b88dd1e4b1309ceb0067fcaba88977a.png[/img]

New DLC released! Like Halloween candy, it's free!
So go check out Cicini's Halloween DLC!
Her plans include new mini side story, new areas, new enemies and a whole new boss fight! 
Some characters will be in Halloween costumes!
Someone else in the game will also be offering you something special...

http://store.steampowered.com/app/547660/

[b]Ver 1.70 Patch Notes[/b]

[h1]More Features[/h1]
- Four new achievements (Halloween DLC)
- Added Comic 5B: Access them from the main menu!
- Added Sandbag Mini Game Leaderboards
- The teaser areas featured in V1.65 have been officially closed off. Please look forward to future updates!*
- Init Loading Screen now display which DLCs are downloaded and installed! Make sure the Halloween DLC is there or the Halloween event will not start!  

[h1]Minor Bug Fixes and...[/h1]
- Fixed some glitches/unintended behavior of Erina interacting with the maps**
- Texture + Tileset Optimization
- Fixed text errors.

[h1]DLC-Related Changes[/h1]
- Artbook DLC Portrait Viewer now support Halloween DLC's new Portraits.
- In-Game Sound Test now have new features if Rabi-Ribi Original Soundtrack DLC is installed.ːrbrbr2ː
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/e04bdefaecfa595e1858207a07fee842aa812c84.png[/img]
- "Cicini's Halloween" new music is now added to Original Soundtrack DLC in FLAC and OGG format.

*	Ver. 1.65: For speedrunners and the curious, this version can still be activated through the games' beta menu.
**	Glitches: Does not apply if "V1.08 Hammer Roll" is On.

notes.title: Ver 1.60 Pandora's Pretty Crystal (Display) Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Features[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/2719d6617db3d47e8e532ebeb9a0fe2d7136b790.png[/img]
- Erina's Hitbox is now displayed at the beginning of boss fights and when using "Slow Movement". 
- Bunny Amulet regeneration speed further increased with Regen Up.
- Each New Game+ Loop now gives a +12 Max PP bonus. 
- 99 PP Limit Removed.
- Soul Heart now gives a Max HP + 5% bonus. 
- These items no longer affect boss level: Carrot Shooter, Spike Barrier, Soul Heart 
(Sunny Beam, Healing Staff, Explode Shot, Chaos Rod and Strange Box already have no affect on boss level) 
- Added "??? Boss Rush". A preview of a upcoming new Boss Rush.
- Added an achievement.
- Added Comic 4A and 4B. ːrbrb1ː

[h1]System Tweak[/h1]
- Xbox Controllers: The B Button now acts as a cancel button to fit with the XBox Controller Standard. A and B Button will always act as Confirm/Cancel no matter how the keybind is changed.
- Rearranged option menu items. (Setting are all reset in this update.) 
- Renamed options setting file to "options.dat". 
- "Resolution" added under "Video and Sound". The default setting is 720p but now you can change it to 1080p or even 4k. (Cicini: "...4K Pixel...?")
- You can also reduce the render resolution to get a big performance boost. 


[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/cbc2e95bbf57157c487f7f867b15bb176183942e.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/fbc395feddbff35880fa9d1d9fcb81a46b320e9f.png[/img][/url]
[b]720p Rita, Erina and Ribbon[/b]

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/601d0f6ccfe64958693d39bd131c1794e22e06b2.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/62731c9922e0ba63c20f0f4f93de4d1f91ea5a1c.png[/img][/url]
[b]v1.60 1080p Rita, Erina and Ribbon[/b]

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/e1de59b509c36e9e9842a9dd101c5026f381ab59.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/262e44922ea4375bea3b3f15360022ba477e73da.png[/img][/url]
[b]720p Map Screen[/b]

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/fff1da67975dc6226057806052fef9c46755cabc.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/4be65e094892da1752383965181ba6c33e6d7a14.png[/img][/url]
[b]v1.60 1080p Map Screen[/b]

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/eedf9b86b73cb29fed8bc50acd15b527f6856d23.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/95ec423288e2448b2818ff546ab822e55ca7acba.png[/img][/url]
[b]720p Artbook DLC[/b]

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/d8f6bab158e89cdcaeaa5299b38ceb17f063112c.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/572fd8f9a5674a8a13e121039bdc6cbc34332a2c.png[/img][/url]
[b]v1.60 1080p Artbook DLC. Enjoy higher quality character art! [/b]

-  Rearranged Option menu Items. (Setting are all reset in this update.)
-  Rename options setting file to "options.dat".
-  B Button on XBox Controller now act as cancel button to fit XBox Controller Standard. A and B Button will always act as Confirm/Cancel no matter how the keybind is changed.
   
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
- Fixed a bug where defeating a boss during her teleporting would soft lock the game. 
- Fixed a bug in Nieve's boss fight that affected hit registration. 
- Fixed missing T.Chinese item descriptions. 
- Fixed a text overlapping problem in S.Chinese. 
- Fixed minor errors in German and French story dialogues. 
- Fixed minor errors in Japanese text. 
- Fixed minor texture errors. 
- Fixed some text using the wrong font (Arial). 
- Fixed possible Cocoa disappearing bug in New Game+. 
- During Seana's 2nd Boss Battle, NPC dialogues will be skipped if the player retries after a Game Over.
- Buff/Debuff names will now stay hidden in Boss Rush and Loop3+. 
- Changed minor terrain in Golden Pyramid and Rabi Rabi Ravine. 
- Optimized one of the Starting Forest's background. 
- Launch option "Reset all settings / Safe Mode" now deletes all save thumbnails to fix a possible corrupt image crash.

[h1]Advanced Launched Option  (Rabi-Ribi > Properties > Launch Options)[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11358524/22fe8992568b15c114be3e3e2896769f12e82875.png[/img]

- Added "-monitor0" to "-monitor6" for launching the game in different monitors. 
- Added "-softsound" to disable hardware sound mixing 
- Added "-nosound" to disable audio output. 
- Added "-safemode" to reset all settings. 
- Added "-nopreload" to disable texture preloading. 
- Added "-dx9" "-dx9e" to force DirectX Version. 

[quote]
The following options should only be used for troubleshooting and may do more harm than goodːrbrb3ː: 

-dx0 -4:3 -16:10 -21:9 -70hz -75hz -85hz -100hz -120hz -144hz -165hz - 200hz -xaudio2 -fasttexture -16bitcolor -nobilinear
[/quote]
- and two hidden bonus launched options...

notes.title: Ver. 1.06 Sha...Syaro's XP Maintain Patch
notes.notes:
Ver. 1.06 Sha...Syaro's XP Maintain Patch

- Better Windows XP support
- You can now change game difficulty by talking to an NPC at Rabi Rabi Park* (Warning : Irreversible!)
- Ingame BGM name display (Can be toggled in the Options Menu)
- Recoded some parts of the game to make it run smoother/use less CPU resources
- Added "No Time Display" in the "Speedrun Info" Option
- Changed VSYNC settings in Options
- Fixed a crash bug related to using Cocoa Bombs in certain areas
- Fixed "Avoid Chapter 5 Boss from spawning" bug. 
- New Achievements
- Increase performance of the Underwater Area (Performance/VLow Graphic Mode only)
- Buffed Combo Hammer V's initial damage

*About difficulty NPC:
-Not available after post game
-Cannot increase difficulty if current difficulty is Hard or above
-Can reduce the difficulty at any time, but can only increase the difficulty at the very beginning of Chapter 1.

About performace issues:
- For notebook users please ensure the game is running with the dedicated graphics card.
- Please ensure Anti-Virus software is not checking rabiribi.exe activity (at least ignore checking the save folder)
- Please disable all IME/Input Method

Also don't forget to check out our official 4 Panel Comic "Player Erina's Rabi-Ribi!" Vol.1ːrbrbr2ː (currently English & Chinese only)
http://www.pixiv.net/member_illust.php?mode=medium&illust_id=55485658
